name: csplib_prob008_spec_example
note: published: the example in the CSPLib prob008 specification (https://www.csplib.org/Problems/prob008/), 16x16 deck, classes A 6x8 4x6 4x4, B 4x4 4x4 4x6, C 4x8 4x8 4x6 4x6, B and C at least 4 apart; the same containers as the listed harder-minizinc.dzn instance but with separation 4 instead of 2

name: tiling_rotation
note: chosen by hand: non-square 10x6 deck whose area the three containers fill exactly, so a model without rotation or with a loose non-overlap fails; one class, separation 0

name: same_class_separation
note: chosen by hand: non-square 12x8 deck, 2 classes, class 2 containers must be 1 apart from each other (non-zero diagonal) and 2 apart from class 1
